text:
carmen: Who started the Paperclip Olympics tradition? Asking for a friend who just found the tiny podium in the supply closet. :medal_sports: :laughing:
pete: That was me, 2019. Events include: staple flick, highest stack, and synchronized binder-opening. The podium is glued to the 2nd shelf. :trophy: (reactions: :raised_hands:)
ivy: Synchronized binder-opening is peak performance art. We had judges from eng and product. Devon still has the ribbon.
devon: I have receipts (photo). Also petition to add a new event: stealth-supplies retrieval. Winner gets the honorary nickname: "Clipper General". :crown: (reactions: :laughing:)
facilities-bot: facilities-bot: Reminder: Please return communal supplies after events. If you use the podium, sign it out on the maintenance log: https://intranet/tools/maint-log (automated)
carmen: Official poll: Reinstate the Olympics this Friday at 4pm in the pantry? Snacks provided by whoever loses the first round. :popcorn: (reactions: :thumbsup: :clap:)
pete: I'm in. I'll bring the foam laurel wreaths. Pro tip: duct-tape the podium feet for extra drama.
ivy: I'm judging if I can bring my clipboard of extremely serious criteria. Dress code: office formal + optional glitter.
lunch-bot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 16:00 6#8211; Paperclip Olympics, Pantry. Free granola bars for participants. (automated)
devon: Also, new lore entry: winners get a tiny plaque and the eternal right to use the nickname for two weeks. See you there, hopeful Clipper Generals. :sparkles:
